# UsingInclusionOnceReturnValue

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> 

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `UsingInclusionOnceReturnValueInspection`

`include_once`/`require_once` return the file's value only the first time;
every later evaluation returns `true`. Code that uses that value works once
and then silently breaks. Use `include`/`require` when the result matters.

## Example

```php{2,3,4,5,6}
<?php
$routes = require_once __DIR__ . '/routes.php';
$ok = include_once $first ||
    include_once $second;
while (include_once($plugin)) {
    register((require_once $plugin));
}
require_once __DIR__ . '/bootstrap.php';
include_once('helpers.php');
$cfg = (require 'config.php');
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Only the first include_once/require_once returns the file&#39;s value; later ones return true.</li>
<li>line 3: Only the first include_once/require_once returns the file&#39;s value; later ones return true.</li>
<li>line 4: Only the first include_once/require_once returns the file&#39;s value; later ones return true.</li>
<li>line 5: Only the first include_once/require_once returns the file&#39;s value; later ones return true.</li>
<li>line 6: Only the first include_once/require_once returns the file&#39;s value; later ones return true.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "UsingInclusionOnceReturnValue": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore UsingInclusionOnceReturnValue

/**
 * @noinspection UsingInclusionOnceReturnValueInspection
 */
```
